content: The recommended build order for a UI redesign + suggestion engine in a Rails+Vue monorepo is: (1) establish the design token system and primitive components in a side branch so the redesign is unblocked; (2) add the BGG poll parser and data model (BggPoll/BggPollResult) without changing the suggestion engine yet, backfilling existing BggThing rows via a one-time job; (3) build the Group Detail view, route, and GraphQL queries because it surfaces existing data; (4) implement the poll-based suggestion engine service and wire it to the session view; (5) redesign the Home dashboard and Collection view using the new primitives; (6) integrate the redesigned Picking a Game screen. This ordering keeps the data work (polls) ahead of the UI work that depends on it, while the design system can proceed in parallel once tokens are defined.
